verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own engineering blog states it "works perfectly offline" and even on a terrible connection, in a post about architecting the web app to work offline. That clearly claims the core of the story. However, the evidence never spells out which actions are available offline or how changes sync on reconnect. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of offline search and composing, documented sync-on-reconnect behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of offline use.
